purpose: Define feature/use flags as explicit configuration identities controlling declared optional behavior without becoming capability, installation or authorization.

topics.name: Feature Flag Identity
topics.purpose: Define feature/use flags as explicit configuration identities controlling declared optional behavior without becoming capability, installation or authorization.

semantics.identity_rule: Each feature flag has explicit identity.
semantics.activation_rule: Flag eligibility and actual runtime activation remain separate.
semantics.security_rule: Flag cannot silently disable mandatory security/governance invariants unless the canonical product profile explicitly defines that mode.
semantics.authority_rule: Flag enabled does not grant caller rights.

invariants.rule: Machine-significant identity, type, relation, state and meaning are explicit and never inferred solely from display text, path, layout, file order, timestamp or implementation accident.
Resolved, projected, indexed, cached, formatted or derived representations never become source-of-truth or authority merely because they are convenient or available.
